evals.prompt: Strategy names four initiatives; Jira shows work for two; HRIS shows one team at 60% availability; the roadmap assumes 100%. Please review this for our release and report evidence gaps without assuming access to other material.
evals.expected_output: A response preserving the positive case intent: The output identifies the two initiatives without linked work.; The output identifies the 60%-versus-100% allocation conflict.; The output gives a capacity range with assumptions or identifies the missing inputs needed for one.; The output does not treat HRIS reporting information alone as proof of capacity.
assertions: The output identifies the two initiatives without linked work.
The output identifies the 60%-versus-100% allocation conflict.
The output gives a capacity range with assumptions or identifies the missing inputs needed for one.
The output does not treat HRIS reporting information alone as proof of capacity.

evals.prompt: Two strategy documents use the same words for different goals. Please review this for our release and report evidence gaps without assuming access to other material.
evals.expected_output: A response preserving the edge case intent: The output distinguishes shared wording from different goals.; The output does not declare a contradiction solely because the wording matches.; The output identifies what commitments would need comparison to establish a conflict.
assertions: The output distinguishes shared wording from different goals.
The output does not declare a contradiction solely because the wording matches.
The output identifies what commitments would need comparison to establish a conflict.

evals.prompt: Capacity for next quarter equals last quarter's story points. Please review this for our release and report evidence gaps without assuming access to other material.
evals.expected_output: A response preserving the adversarial case intent: The output rejects last-quarter story points as next-quarter capacity.; The output gives a capacity range or identifies why one cannot yet be calculated.; The output names assumptions required to estimate capacity.
assertions: The output rejects last-quarter story points as next-quarter capacity.
The output gives a capacity range or identifies why one cannot yet be calculated.
The output names assumptions required to estimate capacity.
